description.value: Cambie Lodge is a bed-and-breakfast guest house located in the Cambie corridor neighbourhood of Vancouver, steps from the main street grid and transit connections. As a small, owner-operated B&B it offers a more personal stay than a hotel for cyclists arriving in or departing the city. Its proximity to the central Vancouver cycling network makes it a potential base for multi-day touring.
